settings.text: Take your content to new heights with the LUMIPIA 81" Magnetic Tripod. Whether you're vlogging, livestreaming, or taking full-body selfies, this ultra-adjustable tripod makes it effortless—with a powerful magnetic mount for quick setup.

Enhance Your Content Creation with the Magnetic Selfie Stick Tripod

Take your photography and videography to the next level with our advanced magnetic selfie stick tripod. It is the ideal tool for content creators who demand versatility and reliability. Whether you're vlogging, live streaming, or taking stunning selfies, this mount doubles as a high-performance magnetic phone tripod.

MagSafe & Magnetic Accessories Compatibility

Our innovative design is fully MagSafe compatible and engineered to work seamlessly with iPhones or phones with magnetic accessories, ensuring a secure connection to your smartphone. No matter how dynamic your shot, theMagSafe selfie stick stays in place. 

Panoramic Shooting Range

The Magnetic selfie stick tripod extends from 18" to 70", transforming your device into a tall phone tripod. This allows you to easily capture wide-angle selfies, stunning landscapes, and creative photos.

Compact & Portable Design

This portable selfie stick tripod folds quickly to a compact size that fits easily in your bag, making it the perfect travel companion for outdoor photography and on-the-go content creation.

360° Rotating Light Head

Featuring a fully 360° rotating light head, this accessory—when detached from the magnetic base—lets you install your lighting equipment to achieve perfect illumination for any scene, further enhancing its functionality as a magnetic light stand tripod.

User-Friendly Operation

Enjoy simple, intuitive controls that make adjusting light settings and positioning effortless—ideal for both beginners and professional creators using this versatile selfie stick.

Why Choose Our Magnetic Selfie Stick Tripod?

Whether you’re a photographer, streamer, or content creator, this must-have accessory elevates your creative output. Its versatile design—serving as a portable selfie stick, a magsafe selfie stick, and transforming into a magnetic phone tripod or tall phone tripod when needed—ensures you capture every moment exactly as you envision it.Grab yours today and elevate your content creation experience!
